data.long_meaning: Hejakatun is a name of Arabic origin meaning 'Divine Protection'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'h-j-k' which means 'to protect'. Hejakatun is a name that conveys a sense of safety and security, and is often given to babies as a reminder of God's protection and care. The name Hejakatun carries the meaning “Divine Protection” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hejakatun usually hope their child will grow to embody divine protection and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_urdu.name: ہیجکاتون

in_hindi.name: हीजकातुन
in_hindi.meaning: एक ऐसा नाम जो इज़्ज़त और रिफ़्त की निशानी हो
